description: This file contains utility functions for handling zoom configurations and drag graphics in an ECharts-based visualization, including position calculations, graphic creation, and zoom level computations.

methods.name: getDragGraphicPosition
methods.description: Calculates the pixel position for a drag graphic based on chart data and bar width.

methods.name: createDragGraphicOption
methods.description: Creates an ECharts graphic option for a draggable circle representing a bar handle.

methods.name: createDragGraphicOptions
methods.description: Generates multiple drag graphic options for all bars in the data set.

methods.name: zoomConfigsToData
methods.description: Converts zoom configuration objects into ECharts data array format.

methods.name: dataToZoomConfigs
methods.description: Converts ECharts data array back into zoom configuration objects.

methods.name: toFixedConfig
methods.description: Converts base zoom config to a fixed shape zoom config with computed values.

methods.name: toLinearConfig
methods.description: Converts base zoom config to a linear shape zoom config with computed values.

methods.name: toExpConfig
methods.description: Converts base zoom config to an exponential shape zoom config with computed values.

methods.name: computeConfigValues
methods.description: Computes zoom level values based on the type of zoom configuration (fixed, linear, exponential).
